twin.config_transformer

Config Transformer Module Applies scaling parameters to baseline configuration for simulation. All parameters are treated as multipliers where 1.0 = baseline.

logger

Transforms actionable parameters into configuration overlays

class twin.config_transformer.ConfigTransformer(base_config_path: str | None = None, db_path: str | None = None)

Transforms actionable parameters into configuration overlays for the MES data generator

Initialize the ConfigTransformer.

Parameters:

  • base_config_path – Path to base MES data config. If None, uses path from configuration.

  • db_path – Path to SQLite database. If None, uses path from configuration.

Raises:

KeyError – If required paths not found in configuration.
